name.value: Middle Beach Lodge At The Headland

description.value: Middle Beach Lodge occupies 40 acres of secluded West Coast oceanfront just outside Tofino, offering two lodges, twenty self-contained rustic cabins, and distinctive treehouse accommodations perched in the forest canopy. The property encompasses nearly a mile of private beach, rugged headlands, and a hand-cut forest trail system designed for slow, quiet exploration. Touring cyclists are 3 kilometres from Tofino's village services and can dine on-site at the Headlands Lounge.

address.value: 400 MacKenzie Beach Road, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0
